---
name: Design proposal
about: Suggest a change to Kalandra's language, APIs or tools
---

Ideas at any stage are welcome. A few sentences are enough to start a discussion;
you do not need a complete specification or an implementation. This template is
optional, and you can delete any sections you do not need or open a blank issue.

## Idea

What would you like to change, and what problem would it solve?

## Examples (optional)

Show how you would like to use it. Pseudocode is welcome; label it as such.

## Alternatives and questions (optional)

Are there other approaches, tradeoffs or things you would like help figuring out?
